comment: Written by QA (it2 verify) from intake/INTAKE_CARD.md §6 and intake/alignment.json mesh_region_desc (primary: PCB top face; secondary: mounting hole H1 wall; clock: +X short board edge outward normal), not from builder code. Same region definitions as the it1 QA spec (like-for-like). Regions only SELECT raw-scan faces via the intake matrix; every fit is QA code on the raw scan.

primary.comment: PCB top face (component side, solder mask): faces near the datum board top, inside the board outline

position.comment: mounting hole H1 bore wall (single inner wall, no counter-wall in the selection), below the board top

clock.comment: +X short board edge (outward normal, far side from H1) -> +X; edge wall only, below the board top
